summary: Very early yesterday morning, United States President Donald Trump reported he and his wife First Lady Melania Trump tested positive for COVID-19; their 14-year-old son Barron and Senior Advisors Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump tested negative, while senior advisor Hope Hicks had tested positive on Thursday. Trump posted on Twitter at 12:54 am local time that they would begin quarantine and recovery immediately, and Marine One flew him to Walter Reed National Military Medical Center in Bethesda, Maryland, where officials said both were showing "mild symptoms" and senior administration officials were tested. Presidential physician Sean Conley said Trump has been given zinc, vitamin D, Pepcid, a daily Aspirin and a single dose of an experimental polyclonal antibodies drug from Regeneron Pharmaceuticals; according to official statements Trump will continue performing his duties as president from WRNMMC during a 14-day quarantine and Vice President Mike Pence could assume duties under the 25th Amendment if Trump became incapacitated, with the Pence family testing negative and no changes to Pence's campaign events.
